name: Emerald Shrine
description: A round burial shrine opens beneath a cracked dome painted with green stars. At its center, a stone bier holds a sword-shaped hollow that shines with emerald light.
challenges: The sword-shaped hollow demands proof of courage before it releases the Emerald Sword.
Disturbing the bier wakes the dead guardians sealed in the wall niches.
clues: A kneeling knight mosaic points its blade toward the bier and its shield toward a hidden release stone.
The emerald light brightens when a living hand is placed on the dragon oath carved into the bier.

notable_events.event: The Emerald Sword was sealed here after the last Dragonkin lord fell, awaiting a claimant brave enough to bear it.

features.name: Stone Bier
features.description: A dragon-carved slab containing the glowing hollow where the Emerald Sword rests.

features.name: Guardian Niches
features.description: Narrow burial alcoves holding the wrapped dead of ancient tomb sentinels.

completion.objective: Claim the Emerald Sword from the stone bier.
signals: the player takes the Emerald Sword
the sword is claimed from the bier
the shrine's guardians are overcome and the sword is taken
